retrieved_chunks.title: Meta_has_a_moderation_bias_problem__not_just_a__bug___that_s.txt
retrieved_chunks.excerpt: It isn’t just Stories. The Arab Center for Social Media Advancement (7amleh), which documents cases of Palestinian digital rights violations and works directly with social media companies to appeal violations, told TechCrunch it has received reports of Instagram inconsistently filtering comments containing the Palestinian flag emoji. Users report that Instagram has flagged comments containing the emoji as “potentially offensive,” hiding the comment.

retrieved_chunks.title: Meta_has_a_moderation_bias_problem__not_just_a__bug___that_s.txt

retrieved_chunks.title: Meta_has_a_moderation_bias_problem__not_just_a__bug___that_s.txt
retrieved_chunks.excerpt: Meta forbids support of terrorist organizations, like most social media companies based in the U.S., but struggles to moderate content around it, from user discourse to journalistic updates. As EFF points out, something as simple as Hamas’ flag in the background of an image can result in a strike.
